job.description:

job.title: Project Coordinator - Banking
job.description:
Job details

6 months contract ,renewable

job.title: Risk Control and Compliance Analyst - Banking [Up to 24K/mth]
job.description:
Job Responsibilities
  • Assist in the execution and maintenance of controls to ensure daily operations comply with all Bank policies and procedures.
  • Support periodical assessment exercises, control self-assessments, and department health checks to mitigate risks and meet audit and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist in promoting risk & control awareness within Digital and support staff compliance training initiatives.
  • Participate in regular assessments including RCSA, ICA, and BCP exercises.
  • Provide support during internal and external audit reviews.


Job Requirements 
  • University Degree or equivalent, preferably in Business or Economic or Finance.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience from banking or Big 4 industry 
  • Sound understanding of banking operations, internal control, and compliance principles.
  • Detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Good interpersonal, communication and presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in spoken / writing skills in both English and Chinese.

job.title: Marketing/ Communication Executive - Banking (Up to $32k/mth)
job.description:
Our client is looking for a skilled Marketing/ Communication Executive to manage the day-to-day operations of an interactive customer community for a leading bank. This community provides Mainland customers with an online platform to exchange their banking experiences in HK and co-create banking journeys with the bank to best meet the needs of Mainland customers. It also promotes customer advocacy through word-of-mouth marketing.

Responsibilties:

• Reviewing posts and comments published in the community by members on a daily basis
• Responding to customer posts and answering simple, unauthenticated inquiries
• Staying alert to incidents and complaints and escalating them as appropriate
• Sharing engaging posts related to banking topics that Mainland customers are interested
• Compiling a monthly newsletter with a member activity dashboard
• Creating engagement activities to maintain member interest and participation
• The candidate may be required to work specific hours on weekends and public holidays based on business needs.

Requirements:
• University degree holder
• 3 - 5 years experience in social media content management in banking field
• Excellent communication skills in both verbal (Putonghua & Cantonese) and written Chinese (simplified & traditional) and English
• Have good understanding of social media trends and popular culture of Mainland China, with a good sense of humor
• Good analytical skills and attention to detail

job.title: Product Designer, UIUX - Banking [Up to 35K/mth]
job.description:
Job Responsibilities 
  • Turn visions into concepts and translate those concepts into designs that illustrate simplicity despite system complexity.
  • Utilize industry design standards and best practices to define screen designs, design guidelines, and design specs 
  • Ensure UI/UX and visual design communicates clearly, is on brand, and delights users
  • Partner with Product Owner, Business, and IT to ensure the project meets its purposes and strategic objectives
  • Manage the design process, drive decisions, track design issues and ensure that design specifications are implemented
  • Present in a clear and compelling way to team members and stakeholders
  • Support Design Researchers in carrying out participatory and iterative design techniques, including observational studies, customer interviews, usability testing, and other forms of qualitative and quantitative research to uncover insights, learn about user behavior and verify design concepts 
  • Maintain a view of emerging industry developments / trends on digital services to ensure the future strategy for the product developments are aligned with evolving developments in the market
  • Collaborate and share knowledge with team members and stakeholders
  • Contribute to the definition and creation of flexible, coherent design systems and component libraries
  • Improve user interaction and interface within an Accessibility framework
  • Promote User Centered Design principles and best practice within banking


Job Requirements 
  • At least 3+ years of experience in UI/UX Design
  • Ability to understand detailed complex requirements to design elegant solutions for complicated processes
  • Ability to clearly and effectively communicate ideas and solutions to stakeholders
  • Be open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism
  • Be passionate about all things UI/UX and other areas of design and innovation
  • Proficient in UI/UX and interaction design with keen eye for branding, visual design, typography and user interface design and also an understanding of user centered design process
  • Strong experience across desktop & native mobile app design
  • Proficiency in UI/UX Software (Sketch, Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, InVision, Flinto, Zeplin)
  • Experience in User Research techniques and usability testing is a big plus
  • Experience working in an agile/scrum
  • Ability to work within a Design System and propose various concepts within given constraints
  • Good relationship management skills to satisfy a wider range of internal and external customers with conflicting priorities 
  • Strong online portfolio available for viewing
  • Previous experience in the financial sector preferable but not a must

job.title: Senior Logistics Coordinator - Electronic Complonents (Up to $27k/mth)
job.description:
We are seeking a highly professional, reliable, and hands-on Senior Logistic Coordinator to coordinate day-to-day logistics activities with company's Global Integrated Management System.

Duties: 
  • Coordinate day-to-day logistics activities, including shipment scheduling, transportation planning, order fulfillment support, and delivery coordination.
  • Ensure inbound and outbound shipments are processed accurately and on time in accordance with customer requirements, transportation schedules, and company procedures.
  • Coordinate with carriers, freight forwarders, logistics providers, warehouses, customers, and internal stakeholders to facilitate timely and efficient movement of materials and products.
  • Monitor shipment status, transit exceptions, delays, and documentation discrepancies; proactively communicate issues and escalate concerns to the Logistics Manager as needed.
  • Maintain accurate logistics records, shipment documentation, inventory transactions, and transportation data within company systems.
Requirements: 
  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate degree or certification in Logistics, Supply Chain, Transportation, or a related field preferred.
  • 3-5 years of experience in logistics, transportation, warehouse operations, inventory control, or supply chain functions; semiconductor/electronics industry experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of domestic and international shipping processes, freight management, customs documentation, and trade compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with ERP, WMS, inventory management, and transportation management systems.
  • May be required to work overtime and/or weekends based on business needs.

job.title: Manager, Sales Promotions - Insurance
job.description:
Job Responsibilities
  • Design and execute creative sales promotion campaigns, contests, and incentive programs to drive agency production any other Company's KPIs
  • Monitor campaign performance, track budget utilization, and evaluate ROI to measure the effectiveness of promotional activities.
  • Prepare clear rules and regulations, operational guidelines, and administrative workflows for sales contests.
  • Lead end-to-end event planning and execution for major agency events, including Annual Awards Presentation, Overseas Conventions, Sales Meetings, and industrial awards.  
  • Coordinate with external vendors, travel agencies, design houses, and venue operators to ensure seamless logistical execution.  
  • Develop engaging internal promotional materials, e-newsletters, social media content, and presentation decks to effectively communicate campaign details to agency force.
  • Analyze sales data and agent participation trends to gather insights for future promotion designs.
  • Serve as a key contact point for agency leaders regarding promotion inquiries, rules clarification, and incentive tracking.
  • Take ownership of ad-hoc strategic projects assigned by senior management, supporting corporate priorities, business transformation, and distribution growth initiatives.


Job Requirements 
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline.  
  • At least 6-8 years of relevant experience in Sales Promotion, Agency Marketing, Projects Management, or Event Marketing.
  • Direct working experience within the Life Insurance or Financial Services industry (specifically supporting Agency Distribution) is highly preferred.  
  • Strong project management, event organizational skills, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to deal with diverse agency stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, handle multi-tasking under pressure, and meet tight deadlines.  
  • Proficiency in written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin)
  • Proficient in MS Office (PowerPoint, Excel, Word); experience with graphic design tools or CRM tools is an advantage
